why: This is an existence/infinitude question, which per the instructions is only moved by an actual proof, not by new examples or records. Searches found no proof or disproof of infinitude; only an unpublished/non-peer-reviewed vixra claim from 2019 (pre-snapshot and not accepted), computational primality-proof work extending verified exponents up to p=42737, and no new largest known Wagstaff prime since the August 2022 record.
